decisions.reason: The modular mobile processing plant builds directly on the firm's recycling know-how, and the firm's own R&D and university cooperation let it interpret and improve the concept, which already shows a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros per year.
A mobile slow-speed shredder sits at the core of the firm's established offer and has its own page on the website, so the firm can readily learn from market feedback and refine it.
As a multi-model flagship line that extends the firm's modular, environmental-technology direction, it fits existing knowledge and strategic focus, which makes withdrawal very unlikely.
The mobile trommel screen is closely related to the firm's existing screening and processing equipment, so its absorptive capacity supports continued development rather than withdrawal.
